title: The articular infinitive
subtitle: Read an action treated like a noun phrase.
overview: The article can turn an infinitive phrase into a noun-like unit. A preceding preposition often shows the phrase’s relationship in the sentence.
Read the article, preposition, and infinitive together; do not translate the article mechanically as English “the.”

sections.title: Article + infinitive
rows: the act of believing / to believe
because of fearing / because they feared

sections.title: Read the phrase as a unit

items.grc: πρὸ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ἀπέθανεν ὁ φίλος αὐτοῦ.
items.en: Before Jesus came, his friend died.

items.grc: διὰ τὸ φοβεῖσθαι αὐτούς, οὐκ ἐλάλει παρρησίᾳ.
items.en: Because he feared them, he was not speaking openly.
